[b]The invasion begins[/b]

At midnight, june 12th, General Hikmet Baykara received the order. The order everyone had been waiting for. The order to cross the Italian-Dutch border and enter the lawless western shamatine desert. The order to begin the journey to Sal-Baliz and begin the full-scale invasion.

As soon as Hikmet received the order, his troops were readied. In under an hour, a line of tanks and armoured vehicles had been assembled, just inside the border. When the signal came, their engines rumbled to life and they began to speed through the desert, a long trail of dust and smoke behind them. Operation Cobalt strike was now underway, the fate of the Sal-Baliz soon to be decided.

The army of ~120,000 troops and ~20,000 armoured vehicles and tanks is now headed rapidly towards the Kwelahn merchant confederation, where they will refuel and drop off a team of specialisst to help with the Kwelahn people's ongoing crisis. The army is expected to arrive within 3 days, then they will arrive at Sal-Baliz after another 5 days. In the mean time, bombing has been greatly increased, to weaken the Sal-Baliz's already poor infrastructure.

Long live freedom and down with terror!
